headline: SEO Specialist | On-Page Optimization and Technical SEO
summary: Data-driven SEO Specialist with 9 years of experience driving organic growth for leading European tech companies. Proven ability to optimize websites for search engines, improve user experience, and increase organic traffic. Skilled in keyword research, content optimization, technical SEO audits, and Google Analytics. Passionate about staying ahead of the curve in the ever-evolving SEO landscape.

Improved website ranking for key target keywords by an average of 15 positions.
Led the development and execution of a comprehensive SEO strategy for new product launches, resulting in a 20% increase in organic leads.
Conducted regular technical SEO audits and implemented fixes to improve website crawlability and indexing.
Developed and implemented a content strategy that resulted in a 10% increase in organic traffic.
Identified and implemented new keywords to expand search visibility and target a wider audience.
Tracked and analyzed SEO performance metrics using Google Analytics and Search Console.
Collaborated with the marketing team to ensure SEO best practices were integrated into all content and campaigns.
